from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app, items

client = TestClient(app)


def setup_function():
    items.clear()

def test_patch_item():
    create_response = client.post(
        "/items",
        json={"name": "Widget", "description": "Old", "quantity": 10, "price": 4.99},
    )
    item_id = create_response.json()["id"]

    response = client.patch(f"/items/{item_id}", json={"quantity": 15, "description": "Updated"})
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == {
        "id": item_id,
        "name": "Widget",
        "description": "Updated",
        "quantity": 15,
        "price": 4.99,
    }


def test_patch_item_not_found():
    response = client.patch("/items/99999", json={"quantity": 15})
    assert response.status_code == 404


def test_get_not_found():
    response = client.get("/items/99999")
    assert response.status_code == 404
